submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm. Radiator-R2 gives the largest raw simulated pion/kaon separation (about 4.6-4.8 sigma near 3 cm), but it is only specified as a high-index porous radiator and has no documented humidity protection, so I do not select it under the hard ageing/transparency constraint. Radiator-R3 is the porous candidate explicitly specified with hydrophobic treatment, making it the humidity-safe high-performance option. Thickness scans for Radiator-R3 over 1-6 cm show a broad maximum around 3.0-3.2 cm, with repeated 100k-event simulations at 3.0 cm averaging about 3.84 sigma and consistent with the 2025 3 cm summary of 3.8 sigma. Radiator-R1 is likely lower risk as a solid radiator but its best simulated separation is only about 3.0 sigma, so Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm gives the best achievable performance among candidates compatible with the hard humidity requirement.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Simulation scans found R3 separation peaking broadly near 3.0-3.2 cm; repeated 3.0 cm simulations averaged about 3.84 sigma, matching the 2025 summary of 3.8 sigma at 3 cm. R1 peaks near only about 2.9-3.0 sigma. R2 is higher in raw performance but excluded by the hard humidity/transparency requirement due to lack of documented hydrophobic treatment.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Radiator-R3 as one of the three candidate radiators: 'porous radiator with a hydrophobic treatment.'

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is the only porous high-performance candidate documented in candidate_specs.md as having a hydrophobic treatment; Radiator-R2 lacks such protection and was not selected. This selection uses the candidate with documented humidity mitigation to satisfy the hard ageing constraint.
Recommended thickness is 3.0 cm, within the allowed 1-6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm.
